column2: Retain year 151, Demetrius son of Seleucus, departure from Rome, a few men and an unnamed coastal city. No historically inferred port is inserted into the text.
Retain entry into the ancestral royal house and the forces seizing Antiochus and Lysias for presentation to Demetrius. The two captives remain distinct.
Retain the matter becoming known and the prohibition on showing their faces. The face image is not replaced with an explicit execution order absent from his quoted words.
Retain the forces killing the captives and Demetrius taking his royal throne. The narration supplies the killing separately from the preceding indirect refusal.
Retain all lawless/ungodly men from Israel and Alcimus’s wish to serve as priest. The priestly verb here is not automatically upgraded to the explicit high-priesthood noun of verse 21.
Retain the accusers’ claim that Judas and brothers destroyed all royal Friends and scattered them from their land. The allegation remains their speech, not an independently verified report.
Retain the trusted envoy’s inspection and punishment of the opponents and all helpers. The singular he who caused devastation resumes Judas contextually without replacing the plural accused group.
Retain Bacchides among the Friends, rule Beyond the River, royal prominence and loyalty. The region remains a named administrative expression without an inserted river name.
Retain sending Bacchides/Alcimus, confirmation in priesthood and the vengeance command. The inherited names resolve two Greek pronouns contextually and remain provisional.
column3: Does the final command address Bacchides or Alcimus? The source pronoun alone does not establish the inherited named resolution.

column2: Retain plural travel with a large force and singular sending of deceitful peaceful words. The subject shift is not silently made uniformly plural.
Retain refusal to heed the words because of the large force accompanying the envoys’ principals. The military evidence grounds distrust without an added revelation.
Retain the gathering of scribes seeking just terms. Terms is supplied for the substantival just things and does not certify an already proposed treaty.
Retain Hasideans as first among Israel seeking peace. The positioning language is not expanded into an established institutional hierarchy or later sect identity.
Retain their confidence in a priest of Aaron’s line and prediction he will not wrong them. It remains the group’s expectation, allowing the subsequent betrayal to stand.
Retain peaceful words, oath and first-person plural promise of no harm to them or friends. Friends here need not be the royal court title used earlier.
Retain trust followed by seizure of sixty men and death in one day. The inherited passive was written leaves the Greek unexpressed writing subject unresolved rather than naming a psalmist.
column3: Who is the unexpressed subject of wrote, and how should the redundant object expression be represented in a closer draft? No author identification is certified.

column2: Retain flesh and blood poured around Jerusalem and absence of anyone to bury them. Thy follows the quoted divine address; two display lines preserve the quotation without harmonizing its wording to a separate Psalm text.
column3: The quotation’s relation to its Psalm source still needs separate alignment; this comparison concerns the wording printed here only.

column2: Retain fear/trembling throughout the people and their accusation of no truth or justice because agreement and oath were violated. Both the commitment and the oath remain.
Retain Beth-zaith, capture of many deserters and some people, and slaughter into the great pit. The unusual directional violence is not softened into a neutral burial notice.
column3: How exactly does with him relate to the deserting men? The inherited deserted to him remains contextual rather than a settled reconstruction of their allegiance.

column2: Retain Alcimus receiving control of the country and a supporting force, while Bacchides returns to the king. Agency is explicit and not merged between the two leaders.
Retain Alcimus contending for the high priesthood. The explicit high-office noun is preserved here, distinct from the earlier generic priesthood language.
Retain all troublers gathering, control of Judah and a great blow in Israel. Their people preserves the possessive rather than replacing it with an unqualified ethnic label.
Retain Judas seeing all the evil and its comparison as beyond that of the nations. The comparative judgment belongs to this narration and is not removed for stylistic moderation.
Retain travel throughout Judea, vengeance on deserters and restriction on their going into the country. The passive restriction does not add a new named enforcing group.
Retain Alcimus recognizing their strength, inability to withstand them and returning with evil accusations. Evil does not by itself specify that every allegation was demonstrably false.
Retain Nicanor’s distinguished rank, hatred and hostility toward Israel, and command to destroy the people. The paired hostile descriptions are not collapsed into merely an opposing political view.
Retain the large force, Jerusalem and deceitful peaceful words to Judas and brothers. The contrast between outward peace and deceit is explicit.
Retain the proposal of no fighting and a visit with few men to see their faces peacefully. You is plural human address, with no sacred pronoun register.
Retain mutual peaceful greetings and enemies ready to seize Judas. The source does not specify an embrace or kiss, so greeting remains broad.
Propose became afraid of him for became wary of him, preserving the explicit fear force of the verb. Keep discovery of deceit and refusal to see his face again; no claim of cowardice is added.
Retain Nicanor learning that his plan was exposed and going to battle near Caphar-salama. The place form is provisional and not identified with an unstated modern location.

Retain about five hundred casualties and flight into David’s city. The accessed running text supports five hundred; the historically noted five-thousand alternative has not been independently collated.
Retain priests and elders approaching peacefully and showing the whole burnt offering for the king. Some is supported by the partitive expressions and does not imply all priests participated.
Retain sneering, mocking, defiling them and arrogant speech. Defiled remains deliberately difficult instead of being quietly replaced by merely insulted.
column3: What action or verbal pollution is meant by defiled them? The selected verb is retained pending specialist semantic review.

column2: Retain the demand for Judas/army now and the further condition if Nicanor returns safely before burning the house. Do not collapse the two conditions into a simpler unconditional threat.
Retain the priests standing before altar and temple, weeping and speaking. Both cultic locations remain as stated.
Retain Thou/Thy, divine choice, name called on the house and prayer/petition for the people. Two display lines distinguish naming from the house’s purpose.
Retain vengeance, falling by sword, remembered insults and no continuance. Four display lines preserve the successive petitions without softening the imprecation.
column3: Does no continuance ask for no enduring place, no survival or no further stay? The broad inherited noun remains provisional.

column2: Retain Nicanor’s departure, Beth-horon camp and meeting a Syrian force. No larger total is calculated from this unspecified reinforcement.
Retain Judas at Adasa with three thousand and the explicit prayer introduction. No inferred historical identification is supplied for the recalled king in the following unit.
Retain the king’s men speaking blasphemously, Thine angel and one hundred eighty-five thousand struck. Three display lines preserve the antecedent event; no king’s name is inserted.
Retain today’s petition, survivors knowing his evil speech against Thy holy places and judgment according to his wickedness. Three lines retain the change from plural survivors to singular offender.
column3: Does the neuter holy expression include holy things beyond places? The inherited spatial rendering remains provisional.

column2: Retain battle on Adar thirteen, Nicanor’s rout and his own falling first. The temporal first is explicit and must not be weakened to merely early in the fighting.
Retain the army seeing Nicanor fallen, discarding weapons and fleeing. The collective army naturally takes plural they in the English continuation.
Retain a day’s pursuit from Adasa to Gazera and signal trumpets behind them. No distance in modern units or precise marching speed is inferred.
Retain villagers’ outflanking, turning against one another, all falling and not one remaining. The complete-loss claim remains the narrator’s, while the turn expression is explicitly provisional.
column3: Does these turned toward those describe mutual collision, flight back upon others or opposing groups turning? The inherited against one another should not be treated as settled tactical analysis.

column2: Retain spoils/plunder, Nicanor’s severed head and right hand, arrogant stretching and their display beside Jerusalem. The violent display is not euphemized or moved inside the sanctuary.
Retain great rejoicing and celebration as a day of great gladness. Repeated gladness is not reduced merely to an administrative holiday notice.
Retain annual observance on Adar thirteen. No modern festival name or calendar conversion is imported.
Retain the land’s quiet for a few days. Few limits the duration; it must not become a long or permanent peace.
